node.title: Two-sided minimal-index budget for moving Hankel kernels
node.statement: For a generically rank-deficient scalar syndrome Hankel pencil of generic rank rho, the binary divided-power apolar complete intersection gives the same degree-rho generator Q_Z for the right and left kernels. If its primitive parameter degree is e and it has s fixed evaluation-domain factors, Kronecker degree and residual apolarity give (R+1-2rho+s)e<=rho-s. Coupling the resulting regular-block allowance with root incidence bounds all supported slopes. At the official rate-half row this proves the far-CA r+1 bound for every r<=2^39-2, extending the exact adjacent formula to every admissible q<2^167. Only budgets 2^39 and 2^39+1 remain in the first CA-only block.
